fixed.summary: A CSS `filter` function list on an inline SVG element (`drop-shadow()`, `blur()`…, as in `[part="DamageDirection.arc"] { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px …) }`) now draws, as it does on a CSS box. Before, an SVG shape read only the `filter="url(#id)"` attribute and dropped the rule's value without a warning. A rule's `filter` overrides the attribute.
